parsed.same_study_reason: List A concerns a pre-registered field experiment on online fundraising ads for Save the Children (zip-code randomization, spillovers, profitability). List B concerns a cross-country analysis of pharmaceutical R&D contributions, quasi-rents, marginal cost and GDP elasticities. These are clearly different papers.

pairs.reason: Both touch on how extreme values are handled: A5 on trimming/winsorizing driving profitability, B7 on untested outlier/leverage sensitivity. The loci are entirely different (donation profitability vs. country contributions), so they share only the topic.

Both say uncertainty is underacknowledged, but A6 targets confidence intervals around campaign profitability. B9 targets uncertainty not propagated from marginal cost assumptions and index error, a different locus and different study.
